up: List all approved drugs (max_phase = 4) that are indicated for cardiovascular disease. For each drug, return the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), drug name (pref_name from molecule_dictionary), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles from compound_structures), and indication details: mesh_heading, efo_term, and max_phase_for_ind (all from drug_indication). Only include indications that are themselves approved (max_phase_for_ind = 4). The indication must be a cardiovascular disease; apply a broad, case‑insensitive filter: the mesh_heading or efo_term should contain at least one of the following terms: 'cardiovascular', 'heart', 'cardiac', 'myocardial', 'hypertension', 'arrhythmia', 'atherosclerosis', 'stroke', 'coronary', 'vascular', 'atrial fibrillation', 'heart failure', 'peripheral vascular'. Use INNER JOIN from molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno, and INNER JOIN from molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Return all matching rows without any limit. Do not add any extra filters (e.g., no unit restrictions, no relation restrictions, no confidence_score filter).
